test_item_verbatim: RVC2.2) The fade out banner will apply to any message/error that appears where “Check Entire Surroundings” appears

tcs.tc_title: the fade out banner applies to any message shown in the Check Entire Surroundings position
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The rear view camera image is displayed
4. A camera fault has been injected so that an error message is shown
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the error message and check that it appears in the same position as the "Check Entire Surroundings" banner
2. Read the error message and check that it fades out towards the edges of the display
tcs.expected_result:
1. The error message appears in the same position as the Check Entire Surroundings banner
2. The error message fades out towards the edges of the display
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: the fade out banner applies to any message shown in the Check Entire Surroundings position
tcs.test_item:
RVC2.2) The fade out banner will apply to any message/error that appears where “Check Entire Surroundings” appears

(the fade out banner applies to any message shown in the Check Entire Surroundings position)

reasoning: §8.3.1 之驗證點為**該淡出樣式適用於同位置之任何訊息**，故須以**非** Check Entire Surroundings 之訊息驗之；取 §9.2.1 之 `Camera System Unavailable`（`-182` 所驗）為該訊息。與 `-174`（§8.3）之分工：後者驗**該 banner 本身**之淡出與不遮蓋，本列驗**樣式之適用範圍**。
